Record the accepted historical quote separately from any currently accepted quote.

messages.text: Earlier I accepted Q-49-A: $30,000 property coverage from November 1 for an extra $18.
That quote was superseded. Q-49-B keeps the same limit and date but adds $31 for the remaining term.
I still want the higher limit, but I have not accepted $31. Please ask for the new quote acceptance before any change; my earlier yes was only for $18.
